name: Flappy Poire
storyline:
In a strange corner of the internet known as the Delanchy Family Universe, an ordinary pear suddenly became a legend.

Nobody knows how it started. Some say it was born in the skies above Finistère. Others believe it appeared after a mysterious glitch altered reality. What is certain is that the Flying Pear quickly became the center of an ever-growing world filled with secrets, rivalries, hidden codes, and unforgettable events.

As Flappy Poire, players must survive endless obstacle courses while exploring a universe where anything can happen. Meteor storms can multiply your score. Glitch events can distort reality. Disco nights, pirate invasions, zombie outbreaks, and legendary tournaments can completely change the rules of the game.

Along the journey, players unlock rare skins, discover hidden references, enter secret codes, and compete against the world's best pear pilots through the online leaderboard. Every high score brings them closer to becoming part of the legend.

But beyond the obstacles lies a bigger mystery. Why does the Delanchy Family keep appearing throughout the world? What secrets are hidden behind the rarest events? And what awaits the first player capable of reaching the impossible score?

In Flappy Poire, every run tells a new story.

Fly higher. Discover the secrets. Become the ultimate pear.
summary:
Flappy Poire is a fast-paced arcade game where players guide a flying pear through a series of challenging obstacles. Inspired by classic endless-runner gameplay, the objective is simple: survive as long as possible, score points, and climb the leaderboard.

Unlock unique skins, discover secret codes, and experience a variety of special events that can completely change the game. From meteor showers and blizzards to pirate invasions, disco parties, and mysterious glitch events, every run offers new surprises and challenges.

Easy to learn but difficult to master, Flappy Poire combines addictive gameplay, colorful visuals, and a humorous universe filled with secrets and rewards. Test your reflexes, beat your personal best, and become the ultimate Flappy Poire champion.
